edges.label: The flap occurred during Ruppelt's tenure and drove the record volume
edges.note: Blue Book case documentation for the 19 July 1952 Washington radar events survives; 1952 produced the largest single-year report volume of the program's history.

edges.label: Arnold's case entered the official file series from the outset
edges.note: Army Air Forces intelligence investigated the sighting and the case documentation survives in the Blue Book record series now held at the National Archives.

edges.label: Arnold's 24 June 1947 sighting opened the wave that Roswell fell inside
edges.note: The Cascades sighting on 24 June 1947 triggered the national wave; the Roswell recovery followed within two weeks and the Twining memo eleven weeks later.
